name: elpuas/cccbr-orbitas-propiedades
description: Authenticated read-only REST endpoint exposing all CCCBR properties for the Orbitas Marketplace import.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Run php -l on every PHP file outside vendor/.
scripts-descriptions.cbf: Auto-fix coding standard violations where possible.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan static analysis (level 8, WordPress stubs).
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit unit suite (no WordPress bootstrap).
scripts-descriptions.build: Build dist/cccbr-orbitas-propiedades.zip for production (the repository vendor/ is untouched).
scripts-descriptions.build:verify: List the zip's contents and assert it is shippable: runtime files present, no dev dependency, one top-level folder.
